item_short_desc: Rothco’s Dress Socks offer the perfect combination of comfort and style, making them ideal for pairing with oxfords or any dress shoe. Crafted from a soft blend of cotton and nylon, these socks provide a snug, comfortable fit that feels great all day long. Their breathable fabric ensures your feet stay cool and comfortable, while the machine washable design makes them easy to care for. Proudly made in the USA, these socks are designed to fit U.S. men’s shoe sizes 9-12, offering versatility for various foot sizes.
description: Rothco’s Dress Socks offer the perfect combination of comfort and style, making them ideal for pairing with oxfords or any dress shoe. Crafted from a soft blend of cotton and nylon, these socks provide a snug, comfortable fit that feels great all day long. Their breathable fabric ensures your feet stay cool and comfortable, while the machine washable design makes them easy to care for. Proudly made in the USA, these socks are designed to fit U.S. men’s shoe sizes 9-12, offering versatility for various foot sizes. Whether you’re heading to the office, a formal event, or just want to elevate your everyday footwear, Rothco’s Dress Socks deliver lasting comfort with a sleek look. The durable composition ensures these socks will maintain their shape and softness wear after wear, providing reliable performance and style in every step. Designed with precision and built to withstand the harshest conditions, Rothco's collection of footwear and accessories combines durability, functionality, and unparalleled performance. From our Forced Entry Series which features our speedlace and waterproof technologies, to our V-Max Collection designed with lightweight running shoe soles, our diverse range of footwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts. With a rich heritage spanning over 7 decades, Rothco is the go-to brand for all things that keep you standing on your feet.
